question: The National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) was established under the Disaster Management Act, 2005, and is chaired by the Prime Minister of India.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The DM Act 2005, passed in the wake of the 2004 tsunami, created the NDMA under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister. The Act also established State Disaster Management Authorities (SDMAs) and District Disaster Management Authorities (DDMAs).
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Section 3 of the Disaster Management Act, 2005 established the NDMA with the Prime Minister as its ex-officio Chairperson. This followed the lessons of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, which exposed the lack of a unified national authority.
